# `rotate`

Two-finger rotation around a point, in device pixels (element-bounds units). The fingers start on opposite sides of the center and both sweep the given angle around it. Positive degrees turn clockwise on screen. Android only.

## Source

- Kind: class-backed
- Class: `xyz.block.trailblaze.toolcalls.commands.RotateTrailblazeTool`

## Contract

- Visible to LLM: yes (`surface_to_llm: true`)
- Recordable: yes (`is_recordable: true`)
- Host-only: no (`requires_host: false`)

## Input schema

### Required parameters

- `x` — `Integer`
  X coordinate of the rotation center.
- `y` — `Integer`
  Y coordinate of the rotation center.
- `span` — `Integer`
  Distance between the two fingers, in pixels.
- `degrees` — `Integer`
  How far to sweep, in degrees. Positive is clockwise.

### Optional parameters

- `durationMs` — `Integer`
  How long the gesture takes, in ms. Default 600.
